subject: Contract transition, surge credit & orderform checklist
messages:
From: Sasha Bell <sasha.bell@helixdata.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixdata.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract transition + surge credit ask

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the renewal walk-through yesterday. A quick summary from our side and the asks procurement wants reflected in paperwork before we circulate internally to Finance: 

- Term change: move from 12-month to 24-month term starting 2028-07-01.
- Capacity bump: target 2x committed tokens (order form to show new baseline and burst buckets).
- One-time surge credit: Helix had an unexpected usage spike in Q1; we are asking for a one-time credit applied against the initial invoice for 10% of Q1 overage (we can provide meter logs).
- Evidence: SOC 2 report and current data retention/audit logs policy to satisfy our security team.

We attached the latest SOW for context (Helix_SOW_v3.pdf). Procurement would like to see a draft addendum or order form that shows term language, updated price table, and credit line so we can attach a PO.

Can you send a suggested addendum + confirm estimated timeline for legal review and DocuSign?

Thanks — I can fast-track our internal approvals if we have a clear redline path.

Sasha Bell
Head of Procurement | Helix Data
Sasha.Bell@helixdata.com
+1 415-555-0183

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Bell <sasha.bell@helixdata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract transition + surge credit ask

Hi Sasha —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answer: yes, we can do the 24-month term, reflect the capacity baseline/burst, and propose a one-time credit treatment on the initial invoice.

I’ve looped in Marissa (account), Markus (legal) and Kimberly (security evidence) to scope the exact redlines. Proposed next steps from our side: 

1) Legal preflight: Markus to provide targeted redline of MSA + order form addendum (will flag any changes that affect indemnity/termination).
2) Commercial: Marissa and I will prepare a consolidated order form (price table + credit line) and send as a single addendum so Helix can attach PO.
3) Evidence: Kimberly to confirm the SOC2 package and retention logs we can share; if redactions are needed we’ll note them.

I’m attaching a working draft addendum (proposed_addendum_draft.docx) that mirrors the items you requested — it’s intentionally light on legal language to avoid unnecessary back-and-forth. Markus, can you take the draft and add the redline edits you want?

Sasha — if you can confirm the target effective date (you noted 2028-07-01) and whether the surge credit should be described as a credit line vs a bill-back adjustment, we’ll map that in the order form.

Target timeline from our side: legal redline within 48 hours, commercial consolidated addendum within 72 hours, DocuSign ready for circulation early next week assuming no substantive changes.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Senior Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sasha Bell <sasha.bell@helixdata.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@helixdata.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract transition + surge credit ask — legal redline notes

Team / Sasha —

I reviewed Grace's draft addendum and attached a redline (redline_msa_helix.docx). High-level points for consideration: 

- Term swap: recommend an amendment clause that sets the new Term to 24 months and specifies the effective date (2028-07-01) and proration rules for mid-billing-cycle changes (Section 2.1).
- Pricing & credits: propose representing the one-time surge credit as a "Customer Credit" line on the first invoice (not a waiver to terms). This preserves flexibility for both sides and simplifies bookkeeping. Draft language included in Section 3.
- Indemnity & data: no changes to indemnity beyond minor clarifications; however, because Helix is requesting SOC2 logs, we should add a limited-purpose data disclosure addendum that permits us to share the SOC2 report and redacted audit logs subject to NDA (Section 5).
- Termination carveouts: if the term extends to 24 months, add a mutual termination right for material breach with 60-day cure and preserve early-termination fee language (Section 7).

Two legal asks for Helix: please confirm who in your security team will accept the redacted SOC2 and whether any additional contractual language is required for logs access.

I flagged a handful of internal playbooks that might affect the credit calculation — Marissa / Grace, please confirm whether the credit should be capped to X usage units or an explicit dollar amount so accounting can process immediately.

Attaching redline_msa_helix.docx. I will stand by for any countered language — if Helix wants a tracked copy we can prepare one in Word comments.

—Markus Klein
Associate General Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Bell <sasha.bell@helixdata.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract transition + surge credit ask

Hi Sasha —

Thanks — quick operational notes from our side so Procurement knows what to expect: 

- PO: when you’re ready to issue the PO please reference deal HLX-2028-Q2-EXPAND-42 and include the credit line code (we will provide the exact code in the final addendum).
- Credit amount: to help Accounting, can you confirm whether Helix wants the 10% credit expressed as (a) dollar amount against the first invoice, or (b) a percentage credit applied to the overage units? If you share the Q1 usage logs we can calculate both and put the preferred option in the addendum.
- DocuSign: we’ll upload the final redline and order form to DocuSign — expect a link from us once legal confirms the final language.
- Timeline: we should be able to get this into DocuSign by EOD Wed (Pacific) if we have confirmation on the credit calc and SOC2 acceptance channel.

If procurement wants a short mutual action plan, I can send a 1-page with owners and deadlines for signature.

Best —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sasha Bell <sasha.bell@helixdata.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixdata.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract transition + surge credit ask — PO and SOC2 acceptance

Marissa / Grace —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Procurement confirms we'll issue a PO referencing HLX-2028-Q2-EXPAND-42 by Wed. We prefer the credit as a dollar amount on the first invoice — I'm attaching the Q1 meter log snapshot (see Helix_SOW_v3.pdf for meter identifiers) and our internal calc. Acceptable SOC2 delivery: we can accept a redacted report + redacted retention logs under NDA; point-of-contact for security review is Aaron Patel (aaron.patel@helixdata.com).

Please proceed with the redline and DocuSign link when ready.

Sasha

-- End of thread --
